paper_title: Linking Group Influences Charge Separation and Recombination in All-Conjugated Block Copolymer Photovoltaics
source_file: /home/wzfeng/MySearch/PhotoRag/MD/Adv Funct Materials - 2015 - Mok - Linking Group Influences Charge Separation and Recombination in All‐Conjugated Block/auto/Adv Funct Materials - 2015 - Mok - Linking Group Influences Charge Separation and Recombination in All‐Conjugated Block.md

knowledge_points.content: The study compares two all-conjugated block copolymers, P3HT-F-PTBTF and P3HT-PTBTF, where the former contains a wide-bandgap fluorene (F) monomer at the block junction and the latter has a direct link between P3HT and the TBT repeat unit of the acceptor.
knowledge_points.evidence: In the case of P3HT-F-PTBTF, a derivatized fluorene (F unit) resides at the block junction, while for P3HT-PTBTF, the TBT repeat unit forms the block junction. Fluorene is a widebandgap monomer, and, qualitatively, serves to electronically decouple P3HT and PTBTF.

knowledge_points.content: P3HT-F-PTBTF photovoltaic devices exhibit a power conversion efficiency (PCE) approximately 40 times higher than P3HT-PTBTF devices, largely due to a significant increase in short-circuit current density (Jsc).
knowledge_points.evidence: The overall power conversion efficiency is roughly 40 times greater for P3HT-F-PTBTF devices compared with devices made from P3HT-PTBTF. The short-circuit current density (JSC) is an order of magnitude larger for P3HT-F-PTBTF block copolymers.

knowledge_points.content: The optimized P3HT-F-PTBTF solar cells processed from a chloroform and chloronaphthalene mixture achieved an average PCE of 2.24%, a Jsc of 4.73 mA cm⁻², a Voc of 1.11 V, and a fill factor (FF) of 0.424.

The P3HT-PTBTF block copolymer forms a low-energy charge transfer (CT) state at the donor-acceptor interface in the solid state, which is characterized by a redshifted photoluminescence (PL) spectrum compared to P3HT-F-PTBTF.
knowledge_points.evidence: P3HT-PTBTF exhibited an excitation spectrum that is redshifted relative to P3HT-F-PTBTF... We therefore attributed the redshift in the PL of P3HT-PTBTF to the formation of a charge transfer state at the P3HT-TBT junction.

knowledge_points.content: Grazing incidence wide-angle X-ray scattering (GIWAXS) reveals that both block copolymers exhibit a strong out-of-plane orientation of the P3HT π-π stacking direction (010 peak), which is beneficial for charge transport to the electrodes.
knowledge_points.evidence: The (010) peak corresponds to the π-π stacking direction in P3HT and is strongly oriented out-of-plane (qz) in both films, indicating that the aromatic stacking is along the film normal.

knowledge_points.content: Ultrafast transient absorption (TA) measurements indicate that charge separation in P3HT-F-PTBTF occurs rapidly within 0.1 ps, while P3HT-PTBTF shows stimulated emission and significantly suppressed charge generation.
knowledge_points.evidence: P3HT-F-PTBTF exhibits a broad PIA from 650-800 nm from 0.1-1000 ps... indicative of the creation of charge-separated states... In the case of P3HT-PFTBT... stimulated emission is predominant at short times... charge separation is significantly suppressed.

knowledge_points.content: Charge recombination in P3HT-F-PTBTF block copolymers is ultrafast compared to polymer-polymer blends, with approximately 90% of the photoinduced absorption (PIA) signal decaying within 1 nanosecond.
knowledge_points.evidence: While polymer-polymer blends were found to exhibit 30% loss of PIA intensity within 1 ns, here we observe almost 90% loss within 1 ns. Thus, losses through charge recombination are more significant in the present block copolymer systems.

knowledge_points.content: Density functional theory (DFT) calculations of model oligomers show that the LUMO level in the P3HT-TBTF system is localized on the TBT unit adjacent to P3HT, whereas the LUMO+1 in P3HT-F-TBT is delocalized across the fluorene unit and P3HT.
knowledge_points.evidence: For both oligomers, the LUMO resides primarily on the TBT unit, which is adjacent to P3HT in the P3HT-TBTF system... The LUMO + 1 levels are centered around the F unit in the P3HT-F-TBT system, with delocalization across two thiophene repeat units on P3HT and the benzothiadiazole (B) monomer.

knowledge_points.content: The choice of solvent (chloroform vs. chloroform:chloronaphthalene) and thermal annealing at 165 °C for 15 minutes were used to optimize the active layer, though the linking group remained the dominant factor in performance differences.
knowledge_points.evidence: The active layers... were spin cast from either chloroform or a mixture of chloroform and chloronaphthalene (95:5 v/v)... and further annealed at 165 °C for 15 min.

knowledge_points.content: The low-energy interfacial excited state in P3HT-PTBTF is unique to the bulk film morphology; in dilute chloroform solution, both block copolymers exhibit nearly identical photoluminescence and transient absorption spectra.
knowledge_points.evidence: The PL of P3HT-PTBTF is not redshifted in solution and matches that of P3HT-F-PTBTF... This suggests that the interfacial excited state responsible for the redshift in the PL spectra of P3HT-PTBTF only forms in bulk films.
